scope: Bounded primary evidence plus arithmetic; no additional inference, arrivals, native timing, model modification or new hardware. Existing sealed studies untouched.
main_conclusion: No newly verified >5% same-capacity placement gain. Two distinct published-capability screens are possible; their gains must survive matched native controls. Mixed fast/slow GEMV page placement lacks a calibrated execution contract.

page_classes.AiF: No-go for substituting standard page classes into unchanged borrowed-latch GEMV.
page_classes.Cambricon: Dedicated buffers remove the obvious AiF latch argument, but page-class support/timing is unverified rather than impossible.
page_classes.SLIM: Positive SLC-or-TLC device portability; no verified co-resident heterogeneous pool. Table2 also says16channels while methodology prose says8: do not silently select a count.
page_classes.NVLLM: Positive MLC/TLC multi-Vread support; finite buffers can mask latency. No calibrated per-class visible service model.
page_classes.NASiC: Direct MoE/interleave prior already in base; analog multi-state is not digital page-class capability.
required_before_experiment: A legal address→class map on one fixed configuration.
Same GEMV/input/ECC/numerical contract on both classes.
Measured or author-modeled class service after FIFO/ECC, including retention/temperature when claiming shortened tR.
Fixed capacity and same fast-first/frequency plus phase-critical controls.

screens.name: SLIM native batched weight fetch, bounded SRAM
screens.native_evidence: SLIM5.4 explicitly allows read-once GEMM across B inputs and reduce; no inference of AiF PB replay is used.
screens.what_is_newly_eligible: Bounded multiple-request physical mapping under an already described batch engine, not a new batching operator.

peak_only_check.formula: PageBytes*B/(16 MAC/cycle*1GHz); excludes ECC, SRAM traffic, nonlinear ops and outputs.

strong_controls: Identical batch/cohort and expert-centric read-once scheduler for equal-allwidth, simple-balanced and phase-coupled placements.
Fixed64KiB PE total SRAM, with input/output/scratch partition stated; not64KiB free input.
Dense unchanged model; no adaptive thresholding or invented activation quantizer.
Same GEMM/reduce/output costs and full expert-input dependencies for every placement.
screens.cheap_falsifier: Actual TRAIN only, same decode-step B4/B8 cohorts: count union-selected experts and per-die necessary weight pages; compare strongest same-batching placement floor. If ideal placement-only gain is below5%, stop before a serving simulator.
blocking_unknowns: Native command fields and batch limits are not published.
Output format/scales and standalone projection versus fused-FFN interface are not verified.
Dynamic full-vector A8 scaling must not be replaced by the paper fused-neuron flow without proving compatibility.
screens.status: Worth necessary-work bound only; no placement gain established; delegated evidence to boundary by root request.

screens.name: Cambricon two-plane read/compute role placement with fixed NPU
screens.native_evidence: IV-B/C permit one shared compute core and another plane serving sliced ordinary reads to NPU.
screens.hypothesis: Routed row ownership may affect whether a coactive set simultaneously fills the existing core and sliced-read path; this resource asymmetry is absent from homogeneous AiF wave accounting.
strong_controls: Original sectionV optimal workload proportion and2D atomic tiling.
Same sliced-read scheduler, route choices, NPU capacity and fixed one-copy weights.
Best plane coloring/input-affinity baseline; do not compare compute-only weak baseline.
screens.cheap_falsifier: Before implementation, solve a zero-overhead perfect read/compute split relaxation for selected pages with one core per die and finite channel service. If it is at most5% below the best static split, stop. A surviving gap still requires legal row/page lowering and the actual buffer/numeric contract.
screens.caveat: Original paper already optimizes hybrid distribution; no missing mechanism or >5% headroom is proven. Third-party simulator is not primary hardware validation.
screens.status: Lower priority conditional screen, not a recommendation to build a new backend or claim novel hybrid mapping.

rejected_shortcuts: Use28/46us as AiF fast/slow GEMV tiers.
Treat64KiB SLIM PE SRAM as64KiB dedicated input.
Count total batching/read-reuse gain as physical-placement gain.
Import SLIM multi-plane-read future-work as existing capability.
Treat NASiC CAM/ADC or new independent contexts as an AiF software configuration.
Use cell-error variation as visible latency without a safe tR/ready/ECC contract.

prior_closures.note: Both independent same-allocated reviews passed; no evidence in this screen changes that finite L0 conclusion.
